high_level_description: This is a black-and-white Instagram post by Kendall Jenner, as indicated by the username "kendalljenner" at the top of the image. The post was made 11 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The image features a close-up of a person's torso and legs. The individual is wearing black lace underwear with floral patterns. The person's hands are positioned on their lower abdomen and upper thighs, with one hand gently touching the lace fabric. The background is plain white, which helps to emphasize the subject and the details of the clothing.
